The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand how search engines work, imagine the Internet as a massive, endless library. In this library, every website is like a distinct book, and each individual web page is a specific page within that book. If you were looking for a specific fact, you wouldn't read every book from cover to cover; instead, you would use the library's index or catalog system to locate the exact book and page you need. Search engines like Google function as this digital index, helping you quickly find the precise website and page that contains the information you are seeking.
